summary: Saratoga Investment Corp. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a public offering of $85 million aggregate principal amount of 8.00% Notes due 2031, with an option for underwriters to purchase up to an additional $12.75 million within 30 days. The offering is under an effective shelf registration statement on Form N-2, with closing expected August 26, 2026. Notes will be listed on NYSE under symbol SAX. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
